2609.11869.title: Sparse data limit what a mechanistic corrosion model can predict
2609.11869.justification: The extracted content closely matches the abstract’s focus on differentiable inversion of a reduced point defect model for duplex oxide on Nb-stabilized AISI 347 in simulated BWR water, identifiability analysis showing one parameter undetermined and another weakly constrained, dominance of chromium data, divergence from an empirical power law at long times, and the value of a ~3000 h exposure to resolve that separation.

2609.11755.title: Device Engineering and Performance Optimization of Cu2NiGeS4 Thin-Film Solar Cells with In2S3/MoTe2 Charge-Selective Layers: A Computational Study
2609.11755.justification: The extracted content closely matches the abstract’s core SCAPS optimization study of an In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2 thin-film solar cell and its recombination/transport mechanisms, with exact material keywords and generally consistent high-performance claims, though it adds some extra defect-engineering and MoTe2 photocurrent rationale not explicitly emphasized in the abstract and omits the specific reported metrics.

2609.11666.title: Competition between vacancy creation and filling in defect-engineering of hBN
2609.11666.justification: The extracted content captures the same study context and main findings as the abstract—ultra-low-energy Ar+ irradiation of monolayer hBN, predominant boron single vacancies with fewer double vacancies, and significant vacancy filling by Si/C-type impurities that complicates selective quantum-emitter defect creation—while adding extra speculative details not central to the abstract.

2609.11640.title: High-throughput thermodynamic screening of oxide-scale adhesion across the CoCrFeMnNiAl high-entropy alloys
2609.11640.justification: The extracted content closely matches the abstract’s main framework (MAM+McLean/Guttmann screening of RE effects in CoCrFeMnNiAl alloys at Cr2O3/Al2O3 interfaces), reproduces key findings such as oxide-dependent Hf/La ranking inversion, sulfur immunity governed by segregation enthalpy differences, and inverse design logic, though it adds some extra hypotheses and slightly shifts the optimal composition/details versus the abstract.

2609.11602.title: Breaking Water at Graphene Defects
2609.11602.justification: The extracted content closely matches the abstract’s core claims that solvation at a graphene single vacancy qualitatively changes water dissociation from a single concerted gas-phase pathway to two lower-barrier acidic/basic solvated pathways producing SV-H, SV-OH, H3O+ and OH− intermediates that enhance adsorption and affect wettability/interfacial chemistry, while also correctly reflecting the machine-learned potential methodology.

2609.11571.title: Effect of Stress and Surface Roughness on Electrodeposition in All-Solid-State Batteries: A Computational Investigation
2609.11571.justification: The extracted content closely matches the abstract’s core 2D electro-chemo-mechanical modeling of roughened Li/argyrodite solid-electrolyte interfaces, the central finding that stress variations around elongated protrusions drive nonuniform Li deposition while rough surfaces alone do not, the low-i/i0 versus high-interfacial-resistance regime distinction, and the discussion of artificial interlayers.

2609.11459.title: Bottom-up Synthesis of Metastable 2D Hexagonal Copper(I) Iodide on Monolayer and within Bilayer Graphene
2609.11459.justification: The extracted hypothesis closely matches the abstract's core story of low-temperature HI-vapor/annealing growth of metastable hexagonal CuI on/in reduced oxo-graphene with graphene-stabilized phase selectivity and interfacial limitations, though it adds some mechanistic details and stronger claims (e.g., bilayer thermodynamic favoring, reduction pathway specifics, absence on open monolayer in wet chemistry) that are only partially explicit in the abstract.
